jd:

Let’s grow together, enjoy more, and inspire each other. Work #LikeABosch

• Discover new directions: At Bosch, you will find your place. 

• Balance your life: At Bosch, your job matches your lifestyle. 

• Celebrate success: At Bosch, we celebrate you.

Powertrain Solutions is a provider of diversified powertrain products and solutions across all market segments and with a product portfolio ranging from gasoline and diesel injection systems, electronics control units and software, to electrified powertrains with battery and fuel cell technologies.
We are the customer innovation management team within Bosch’s Powertrain Solutions (PS) division responsible for all technical collaboration activities with our customers in North America. We strive to support our customers on their path to a CO2-neutral and zero-emission future. We have access to a global pool of cutting-edge technology development that we utilize to engage our customer and carry these technologies from the innovation phase all the way into series production.
Responsibilities:
Take the lead: You are the engineering interface to our North American customers for internal combustion engine, hybrid powertrains and electrification, fuel cell, thermal management, electronics, software, and connected powertrain projects
You’re in charge: You manage and coordinate all internal and external stakeholders on powertrain innovation and acquisition programs
Deliver excellence: You lead cross-functional project teams to ensure portfolio alignment and customer satisfaction
Leave your footprint: You engage our customer on advanced engineering collaborations and product innovation activities
Keep us on track: You are the technical interface and voice-of-the-customer to our sales and R&D teams for pre-selling activities
Technology Domains:
Internal combustion engines
Electrification / Hybrids
Thermal Management
SW & Controls
  We are looking for engineers with...
High degree of motivation to bring innovations to fruition in direct engagement with the customer
Excellent communication and networking skills paired with high level of self-motivation and a strategic and result-oriented mindset
Ability to thrive in a diverse and multi-national organization by forming long-term relationships based on trust and commitment
Ability to adapt in dynamic and fast paced environments.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering
Deep knowledge of powertrain and thermal management technologies on system level
3-5 years of experience in an engineering, innovation or project management role with interface to external customers
Languages: English. Additional language skills, like German, French, Italian are a plus.

Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only.  Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.
Please note that employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.
In addition to your base compensation, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement plans with an employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; short- and long-term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave, adoption assistance; and reimbursement of education expenses.
Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting: www.myboschbenefits.com. Pay ranges included in the postings generally reflect base salary; certain positions may include bonus, commission, or additional benefits.

title: Robot Operations & Reliability Engineer_PS
jd:
Bosch Powertrain Systems Co., Ltd. (RBCD), the joint venture of Robert Bosch GmbH and Weifu High Technology Group Co., Ltd., is a high tech enterprise specializing in the development, production and sales of common rail systems, exhaust gas after treatment systems, fuel cell stacks and key components. The company, based on its local R&D and project management competence, with innovative technologies, can support customers to continuously improve internal combustion engines efficiency, to reduce emission, and to accelerate the market launch of new energy products. The garget of the company is to provide the Chinese market and customers with diversified advanced powertrain products.

Job Summary
Robot Operations & Reliability Engineer
takes end-to-end responsibility for the operation management of collaborative robots — and, as the product roadmap evolves, humanoid robots — across industrial deployment scenarios,
combines cobot system know-how with software and data capabilities to build data-driven robot operation standards, shorten downtime, and improve OEE, while driving industrial-scale deployment of proven solutions for fast replication across lines and plants.
Roles and Responsibilities
Own operation KPIs of assigned collaborative robot cells — and, as the portfolio expands, humanoid robot deployments —cycle stability, and technical loss reduction.
Solve practical operations-management issues across the full system-integration-to-industrialization journey: from pilot deployment, line integration, and process stabilization through to scaled rollout and cross-site replication.
Lead structured root-cause analysis for recurring faults and long downtime events; define standard reaction playbooks and CIP with field data.
Establish data collection and visualization for robot status, alarms, and process parameters; promote early-warning mechanisms and lay the data foundation for AI/ML-driven optimization.
Standardize spare parts strategy, abnormal consumption tracking, and localization support for critical components, including emerging humanoid robot modules
Coach team members on robot operation standards, troubleshooting logic, and digital tool usage; build organizational capability for the evolving collaborative and humanoid robot portfolio.
Contribute to TPM/CIP and cross-functional initiatives such as energy efficiency, quality improvement, and cost optimization.
Coordinate with suppliers, Development, and internal teams for rapid issue closure, technical upgrades, and process change alignment; bridge the gap between product development and industrial operations.

Qualifications Requirement
Education degree:  Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Robotics, or related fields.
Total working experience  > 5 year
Related working experience >2  years
Job Relevant Knowledge and Experience
Hands-on experience with collaborative robot systems and integration in production environments; exposure to humanoid robot platforms is a strong plus.
Strong problem-solving and structured analysis skills for complex electromechanical and control issues.
Practical understanding of manufacturing KPIs (OEE, FPY, cycle time, downtime loss) and improvement methods.
Exposure to AI-assisted diagnostics, machine-learning-enabled equipment optimization, or LLM/VLM-driven robot applications is preferred.
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Fluent English both in speaking and writing

title: Project Engineer (m/f/i) - Power Generation
jd:
The **Project Engineer – Power Generation Systems (UL 2200 / UL 6200\)** is responsible for conducting technical evaluations, certification assessments, and project management activities for power generation equipment, generator assemblies, and power products.

Location: ***Neu\-Isenburg/Germany***

Work arrangement: ***Hybrid***

  
* Determines project scope, develops a preliminary plan of investigation, and determines project specifications such as cost, time, and sample requirements by analyzing client input, available supplemental data, and product construction.
* Projects may include frequent travel to conduct or witness tests at client sites.
* Communicates with clients to discuss technical issues, explain UL procedures and requirements, convey project cost, and negotiate completion date and sample requirements.
* Acts to address client concerns and to resolve client issues.
* Provides technical assistance to clients in reference to product inspection and follow\-up services.
* Establishes appropriate test programs by reviewing files and manufacturer's information, examining samples, and applying UL requirements.
* Notifies client of any areas in which the product is not in compliance with UL requirements or of any changes in project scope or specifications.
* Coordinates laboratory activities by preparing data sheets and instructions to technicians, scheduling and reviewing work of Laboratory Technicians and support staff and establishing completion dates.
* Coordinates administrative aspects of project management.
* Serves as Project Handler of record and may sign as Reviewer of record as assigned.
* Communicates project status and results to clients through frequent contact and by preparing reports.
* Prepares Follow\-Up Service Procedures and information pages.
* Integrates continuous improvement concepts and techniques into all aspects of the job.
* Resolves engineering issues associated with Variation Notices by analyzing and reporting on the acceptability of the variations.
* Develops special test methods and test equipment.
* Coordinates and/or performs File Reviews.
* May represent UL at industry related functions such as seminars and trade shows.
* May provide direction as a Primary Designated Engineer or Designated Engineer for specific product categories.
* May directs and review work of assigned staff.
* May train office, field, and/or laboratory staff and entry\-level engineers.
* Provides technical assistance to laboratory and/or field staff.
* Read and follow the Underwriters Laboratories Code of Conduct and follow all physical and digital security practices.
* Performs other duties as directed.

  
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or a related technical discipline and a minimum of four years of relevant engineering experience.
* Experience within one of the following disciplines: Genset assemblies (e.g. electrical generating equipment driven by gasoline, LP\-gas, natural gas or diesel\-fueled internal combustion engines), Gas turbines, electrical generators (low, medium and high voltage), controllers in use of power production (from smaller control units up to larger control panels), hydrogen generator (e.g. Solid Oxide Electrolyzer (SOEC) hydrogen generators that electrolyze water to produce hydrogen)
* Detailed knowledge of the technical vocabulary common to power generation systems, industrial control equipment, rotating electrical machines, electrical protection systems, and safety\-related control functions.
* Preferred to have working knowledge of conformity standards in use in area of expertise. ANSI/CAN/UL/ULC 2200, ANSI/CAN/UL/ULC 6200, UL 1004 series, UL 508A, NFPA 70, NFPA 37, NFPA 110, and related certification requirements.
* Ability to independently evaluate complex products, conduct compliance assessments, review risk analyses, and determine certification requirements.
* Demonstrated project management skills, including planning, execution, testing coordination, customer communication, and technical decision\-making.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders.

**Unternehmensbeschreibung**
----------------------------

**100 % fossilfrei:** Daran arbeiten wir seit 25 Jahren und treiben Projekte voran, die andere für undenkbar halten. Mit Wind, Sonne und grünem Wasserstoff erzeugen, speichern und liefern wir grüne Energie. Unsere über 1\.200 Mitarbeitenden arbeiten an Energieprojekten mit einer Kapazität von mehr als 30 Gigawatt weltweit.

**ENERTRAG** entwickelt, baut und betreibt Energielösungen aus Wind, Photovoltaik und grünem Wasserstoff, um die Energiewende weltweit voranzutreiben – und fossile Brennstoffe in der Energieversorgung vollständig zu ersetzen.

Werde Teil unseres Teams in **Berlin, Dauerthal oder Hamburg als Projektterminplaner (m/w/d)** und arbeite mit uns an unserer Mission: Erneuerbare Energien nachhaltig erzeugen. Damit die Erde lebenswert bleibt.

**Stellenbeschreibung**
-----------------------

* Du entwickelst, pflegst und steuerst integrierte Gesamtterminpläne für komplexe Energieinfrastrukturprojekte in Primavera P6 oder MS Project.
* Die Terminpläne von Auftragnehmern und Beratern sowie interne Arbeitspakete und Arbeitsströme führst du zu einem konsistenten Gesamtprojektterminplan zusammen.
* Den tatsächlichen Projektfortschritt überwachst du im Vergleich zur genehmigten Basisplanung und stellst die Nachverfolgung relevanter Projektmeilensteine sicher.
* Kritische und nahezu kritische Pfade, terminliche Risiken, Engpässe und Abhängigkeiten identifizierst und analysierst du und leitest geeignete Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung, Beschleunigung oder Wiederherstellung des Terminplans ab.
* Die terminliche Koordination an den Schnittstellen zwischen Engineering, Beschaffung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Betriebsbereitschaft stellst du über den gesamten Projektverlauf hinweg sicher.
* Look\-ahead\-Pläne, Dashboards, Analysen des kritischen Pfads und Managementberichte erstellst du und unterstützt bei der Bewertung von Änderungen, Verzögerungen und Claims durch fundierte Terminplananalysen.

* Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, Projektmanagement, Baumanagement oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

	+ Die modellbasierten Untersuchungen variieren je nach Projekt im Abstraktionsgrad (0D, 1D, 3D) und werden üblicherweise mit Tools wie Matlab/Simulink, Cantera, GT Power, StarCCM\+ oder Converge durchgeführt

* Durchführung von Übungen

* Fähigkeit zum Unterrichten in deutscher und/oder englischer Sprache; Bereitschaft, die jeweils fehlenden Sprachkenntnisse zu erwerben

* Thermodynamik, Verfahrenstechnik oder Chemie

* Elektrotechnik

* Erfahrungen in CAD\-Konstruktion (Siemens NX, SolidWorks) erwünscht
